title: 一个网络梗：引爆印度全国抗议，教育部长辞职后困局何解？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For over a decade, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his party have dominated Indian politics.
segments.zh: 十多年来，总理纳伦德拉·莫迪及其政党主导了印度政坛。

segments.en: Narendra Modi secures a third term. Modi's BJP wins control of the Indian capital.
segments.zh: 纳伦德拉·莫迪赢得第三个任期。莫迪的印度人民党控制了印度首都。

segments.en: But that dominant political vehicle hit a bit of a roadblock.
segments.zh: 但这一主导性的政治机器遭遇了一些阻碍。

segments.en: The police has barricaded the street and put international numbers in place.
segments.zh: 警方已封锁街道并部署了国际力量。

segments.en: In total, there would have been tens of thousands of protesters converging on the parliament.
segments.zh: 总共有数万名抗议者聚集在议会附近。

segments.en: And it went on for weeks but was triggered by an internet meme, featuring, well, look.
segments.zh: 抗议持续了数周，起因是一个网络梗，看这个。

segments.en: It is, particularly considering that anger isn't directed at the government's pest control record, but its education department and some recent exam scandals.
segments.zh: 尤其考虑到愤怒并非针对政府的害虫防治记录，而是针对教育部门及近期的考试丑闻。

segments.en: The unemployment situation in India is fairly grim. These degliest diplomas and certificates are not enough.
segments.zh: 印度的就业形势相当严峻，仅有文凭和证书是不够的。

segments.en: In late July, the movement scored a win. The country's education minister has resigned after protests over-example paper leaks.
segments.zh: 7月底，运动取得了胜利。在试卷泄露抗议后，国家教育部长辞职。

segments.en: Toppling a minister though doesn't fix a youth job crisis that's only being compounded by artificial intelligence.
segments.zh: 然而，推翻一位部长并不能解决青年就业压力，而人工智能正使这一问题雪上加霜。
